content.comment_body: I upgraded to [version_no] of [product_name] software and installed v6.x of the USB cable drivers. After opening a previously created circuit in version [version_no] and saving it in the new version, I tried to download from laptop to [product_name] but cannot establish a connection. Selecting the USB option and clicking test produces no response. Not sure what to do next.
Besides choosing the USB cable option, you must also pick the correct COM port (e.g., COM5 instead of the default COM1 on my setup). Try selecting different ports to see if that helps.

In version [version_no] of the software, I used to get a dialog to select the port, usually COM8. That dialog no longer appears. Where can I access port selection now? Thanks for your help—it's been a long day trying to upload programs.

I removed [product_name] software and all other versions along with the USB drivers, reinstalled v6.1 from CD, but couldn’t communicate with [product_name]. Upgraded to [version_no] and tried again—no success. Downloaded the 32-bit version—still no luck. My laptop runs Windows 7 64-bit OS, so I also tried the 64-bit version, which didn’t work. After uninstalling everything yet again and installing the 32-bit version of [version_no], nothing changed. I have no idea how to proceed.

Go to File > Properties > Online Settings. With [product_name], navigate to Interface > Connect Through > [product_name] cable, and select the correct COM port. My USB/RS232 converter is detected as COM4.
Hi, have you installed the USB cable driver as per the installation instructions? This must be done before connecting the USB cable to your PC. Regards.

Thanks for your help! Still no success. I removed the device and brought it to my office, but got the same result with [product_name] connected to my office PC. It seems to be a driver issue. The indicator light on the USB cable box stays off, though my PC does recognize the cable with a normal beep. In File > Properties > USB cable dropdown, only the network connection is listed—no other options.
It looks like my USB cable may be defective. I expect a replacement by Wednesday—hoping for better results.
Wishing you the best of luck!
The new USB cable didn’t solve the issue. The replacement came with a driver CD. Is there a recommended folder where I should install the drivers?
Is there a support line I can call for help with this? My machine cannot be used until I resolve this.
I receive a dialog box when clicking on the PC > [product_name].
I see this error message as well.

Problem resolved! Here’s what worked: I removed all installations of [product_name] and drivers, then downloaded the upgrade and separate driver file from [company_name]'s website. I reinstalled v6.1 from CD, then ran the upgrade from my hard drive, making sure not to install the bundled drivers. Instead, I used the separate driver installer, and everything then worked as expected. Thanks to everyone for your help—hope my experience assists others.

To clarify: it was necessary to download [product_name] directly from [company_name]'s website—not through the in-program update option. I also needed to download drivers from a separate source and install them independently, rather than using the program prompt to install USB drivers. Or maybe everything just happened to work out by chance!
A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to another thread titled 'Not able to make a connection between PC and [product_name]'. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced persistent problems connecting their laptop to [product_name] after upgrading the software and completing several installation and troubleshooting steps, including switching USB cables and driver versions. Main issues included disappearing COM port selection dialogs, unreliable device recognition, and unclear error reporting, reflecting challenges with driver compatibility and lack of clear software guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for a reliable and straightforward process to set up communication between their laptop and [product_name] using the recommended USB cable and software, with helpful port selection prompts and automatic device detection when following installation instructions.
